era: 1920 年 7 月 25 日生于伦敦诺丁山一个犹太银行世家， St Paul's Girls' School 接受严格的科学与古典教育——1938 年入剑桥纽纳姆学院物理化学系（1941 年毕业，女性学位迟至战后才被正式授予）——1942 年战时应征入英国煤炭利用研究协会（BCURA），用真密度与表观密度之差测出煤中分子尺度的微孔收缩结构，确立'分子筛'模型，1945 年以《煤与碳质固体的微结构》获剑桥博士，五篇论文三篇独著——1947 年赴巴黎国家中央化学实验室随雅克·梅灵学习 X 射线衍射，成为'把非晶碳拍出衍射图'的一流晶体学家，1950 年《石墨化碳与非石墨化碳中微晶的成长》奠定碳材料分类学——1951 年 1 月回伦敦国王学院 MRC 生物物理单位接管 DNA 纤维衍射：以自装调焦的细焦点 X 射线管与微照相机、自控湿度室把纤维衍射做成定量科学，分出干燥的 A 型与水化的 B 型——1952 年 5 月 2-6 日与博士生戈斯林以 62 小时曝光拍下 Photograph 51：清晰的螺旋十字、3.4 埃子午反射、缺失第四层线——她由帕特森函数与密度论证磷酸骨架在外、碱基在内，1953 年 3 月独立完成两链螺旋手稿——但 1953 年 2 月，兰德尔为 MRC 评审委员会写的报告（含她的精确晶胞数据与两链反向平行结论）经佩鲁茨之手到达剑桥，威尔金斯未经她知许可向沃森出示 Photo 51；4 月 25 日 Nature 同期三文，她的实验数据以'支持模型'的配角身份出场——1953 年转往伯克贝克学院贝尔纳门下，把同样的纤维衍射方法转向烟草花叶病毒（TMV）：1955 年证明全部病毒颗粒等长、确立螺旋每三转 49 个亚基，1956 年定位 RNA 在颗粒内部的位置，1957 年与克鲁格、芬奇解出芜菁黄色花叶病毒（TYMV）结构，开创病毒结构学派——1956 年访美期间确诊卵巢癌，此后仍以十年一贯的严谨连发论文，1958 年 4 月 16 日于伦敦去世，年仅 37 岁；布鲁塞尔世界博览会 TMV 模型在她去世前一天揭幕。
era_en: Born 25 July 1920 in Notting Hill, London, into a prosperous Anglo-Jewish banking family; educated at St Paul's Girls' School — entered Newnham College, Cambridge in 1938 to read physical chemistry (BA 1941, women's degrees formally conferred only after the war) — in wartime 1942 joined the British Coal Utilisation Research Association (BCURA): by comparing true and apparent densities she mapped molecular-scale pore constrictions in coal, establishing the 'molecular sieve' model (PhD Cambridge 1945, five papers, three sole-author) — in 1947 moved to the Laboratoire Central des Services Chimiques de l'État in Paris to learn X-ray diffraction under Jacques Mering, becoming the crystallographer who could photograph amorphous carbons; her 1950 work on crystallite growth in graphitising and non-graphitising carbons founded their classification — January 1951 she returned to King's College London to take over the DNA fibre diffraction work in Randall's MRC Biophysics Unit: a fine-focus rotating-anode tube and micro-camera she adjusted and focused herself, a humidity-controlled chamber, and she separated the dry A form from the hydrated B form as a quantitative science — 2-6 May 1952, with PhD student Raymond Gosling, the 62-hour exposure produced Photograph 51: a sharp helical cross, a 3.4 Å meridional reflection, a missing fourth layer line — from the Patterson function and density arguments she placed the phosphate backbone outside and bases inside, and in March 1953 completed independent manuscripts on the two-chain helix — but in February 1953 the MRC report Randall wrote for a visiting committee (containing her precise unit-cell data and the antiparallel two-chain conclusion) reached Cambridge through Perutz, and Wilkins showed Photo 51 to Watson without her knowledge; on 25 April 1953 Nature carried three papers, her experimental data playing the supporting role of 'agreeing with the model' — 1953 she moved to Birkbeck College under J. D. Bernal and turned the same fibre methods on tobacco mosaic virus (TMV): 1955 all particles of equal length and the helix of 49 subunits in three turns; 1956 the location of the RNA inside the particle; 1957 the structure of turnip yellow mosaic virus with Klug and Finch, founding a school of virus structure — diagnosed with ovarian cancer in 1956 during a US visit, she kept publishing at full rigour and died in London on 16 April 1958, aged 37; the Brussels World's Fair TMV model was unveiled the day after her death.
school: X 射线纤维衍射 / 结构晶体学 / 早期分子生物学 / 碳材料科学
historical_significance: 把纤维 X 射线衍射从'拍照看像'改造为可定量、可复现的结构测定科学：以湿度控制系统分离 DNA 的 A/B 两型并以帕特森函数计算其转换关系；以 Photo 51 与晶胞数据给出双螺旋模型赖以成立的关键实验参数（20 埃直径、34 埃螺距、每转 10 碱基、磷酸在外）；在碳科学上以密度测量确立即'石墨化/非石墨化'碳的根本分类；在病毒结构上以 TMV 的 49/3 转亚基螺旋、RNA 内嵌定位与 TYMV 结构开创病毒晶体学；其一生工作的共同方法论内核——由衍射数据经计算直接确定结构、拒绝以美学直觉搭模型——是结构生物学'实验先于模型'传统的源头之一。
historical_significance_en: Turned fibre X-ray diffraction from 'take a picture and squint' into a quantitative, reproducible science of structure determination: with humidity control she separated DNA's A and B forms and computed their interconversion via the Patterson function; Photo 51 and her unit-cell data supplied the critical experimental parameters on which the double-helix model stood (20 Å diameter, 34 Å pitch, ten bases per turn, phosphates outside); in carbon science her density measurements established the fundamental graphitising/non-graphitising classification; in virology the 49-subunits-per-three-turns helix of TMV, the internal location of its RNA and the TYMV structure founded structural virology; the methodological core of her whole career — structure calculated from diffraction data rather than guessed by elegant model-building — is one of the sources of structural biology's 'experiment before model' tradition.
unique_thinking: 富兰克林的思维内核是'让数据自己说出结构，而不是让结构邀请数据作证'：她对每个研究对象先建立可复现的物理条件（湿度、照距、曝光时长），使'样品状态'本身成为受控变量而非偶然——A 型与 B 型因湿度不同而互变，她以此把'DNA 有两种构象'从混乱变成信息；她坚持由衍射图样经计算（帕特森函数、径向密度分布）直接读出结构参数，对'搭一个漂亮的模型再找数据支持'的方法论 shortcut 保持结构性警惕——剑桥 1951 年三链模型的失败印证了她的怀疑；她对不利于自己先前判断的证据处理得极快：'缺失的第四层线'告诉她两链错位，她随即修正自己对手稿的判断，1953 年 3 月的手稿已写出双链与磷酸在外；在荣誉问题上她拒绝把'别人用了我的数据'当作身份叙事——她离开 King's 时交出 Photo 51，转向全新的 TMV 领域，用下一个原创成果而非诉讼来回应不公；她教学生与同事（戈斯林、克鲁格）的方式是把方法整个交出去——'你可以做得比我好，但必须先学会读图'。
unique_thinking_en: Franklin's cognitive core is 'let the data speak the structure, rather than inviting the data to endorse one': for every object she first built reproducible physical conditions — humidity, focus, exposure time — so that the sample's state itself became a controlled variable instead of an accident; the A and B forms interconvert with humidity, and she turned that from nuisance into information; she insisted on reading structural parameters out of diffraction patterns by calculation (Patterson functions, radial density distributions) and kept a structural suspicion of the methodological shortcut 'build an elegant model, then find data to support it' — the collapse of Cambridge's 1951 triple helix confirmed her doubt; she processed evidence against her own earlier judgements with great speed: the missing fourth layer line told her the two chains were offset, and she revised her own manuscript, writing the two-chain, phosphates-outside structure into her March 1953 draft; on credit, she refused to make 'others used my data' an identity narrative — she handed over Photo 51 when leaving King's and turned to the entirely new field of TMV, answering injustice with the next original result rather than litigation; her way of teaching students and colleagues (Gosling, Klug) was to hand over the whole method — 'you may do better than me, but first learn to read the photograph.'
civilization_zh: 战后英国科学界：战争把女性推入科研岗位又在战后请回家庭、MRC 体制内的集体研究与个人荣誉的张力、犹太中产家庭的公共责任传统（父亲在工人学院义务教书、家收容 Kindertransport 难童）、晶体学在剑桥与伦敦伯克贝克的学脉（贝尔纳学派）
civilization_en: Postwar British science: women pushed into research posts by the war and back out of them after it; the tension between collective MRC research and individual credit; the civic tradition of a middle-class Anglo-Jewish family (a father who taught evenings at the Working Men's College and housed Kindertransport children); the crystallographic lineage of Cambridge and Birkbeck's Bernal school
roles_zh: 物理化学家；X 射线晶体学家；DNA 结构测定者；病毒结构学派开创者；煤与碳材料科学家
roles_en: Physical chemist; X-ray crystallographer; determiner of DNA's structure; founder of structural virology; scientist of coal and carbon materials

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/以样品条件的受控化保证测量可复现
modes.domain_en: Methodology / making sample conditions controlled variables so measurements reproduce
modes.definition_zh: 实验方法论/在采集任何数据之前，先把决定数据意义的物理条件做成受控、可陈述、可复现的参数：DNA 纤维的衍射图样随湿度剧烈变化——前人把这种变化当麻烦，她把它当变量：自建湿度控制室，把相对湿度固定在 75%-92% 的区间并逐点记录，使 A 型（干燥晶态）与 B 型（水化螺旋态）第一次成为有定义、可切换、可互换的实验对象；测量前先定条件，条件不明则数据无声——'这张图是在什么状态下拍的'不是脚注，而是数据本身的一半
modes.definition_en: Experimental methodology: before collecting any data, make the physical conditions that determine the data's meaning controlled, stateable and reproducible parameters — a DNA fibre's diffraction pattern changes dramatically with humidity, and where predecessors treated the variation as nuisance she treated it as a variable: building her own humidity chamber, fixing relative humidity across the 75-92% band with every point recorded, so that the A form (dry crystalline) and B form (hydrated helical) became for the first time defined, switchable, comparable experimental objects; conditions before measurements — an unstated condition silences the data, and 'under what state was this photograph taken' is not a footnote but half of the datum itself
modes.source_chapter: Franklin & Gosling《脱氧核糖核酸钠纤维的结构 I：含水量之影响》(1953, Acta Cryst. 6:673)
modes.key_quote_zh: 纤维在干燥时变短变胖、在吸水时变长变细——这不是麻烦，这是分子在告诉你它有两种活法；先把'怎么活'的条件定住，衍射图才会开口说话。
modes.key_quote_en: The fibre shortens and fattens when dried, lengthens and thins when wetted — that is not a nuisance, it is the molecule telling you it has two ways of being; fix the conditions of that being first, and only then will the diffraction pattern speak.
key_concepts: 湿度控制室 the humidity chamber（相对湿度成为仪器参数而非天气）
条件即数据的一半 conditions as half the datum（无状态陈述的数据不可比较）
可切换的样品对象 the switchable specimen（A/B 两型在同一根纤维上往返）
process_zh: 列出决定数据意义的环境变量：对纤维衍射是湿度，对别的体系可能是温度、pH、浓度——第一动作是问'什么条件一变图样就变'
把变量做成仪器：自装调焦细焦点 X 射线管、自建控湿样品室——条件不是'记录一下'而是'控制到位'
逐点标定条件-图样关系：同一纤维在不同湿度下往返拍摄，A/B 转换可逆——证明你测的是规律不是运气
在发表中把条件写成方法而非脚注：1953 年 Acta Cryst. 论文以'含水量之影响'为题——条件本身成为论文的贡献
process_en: List the environmental variables that decide what the data mean: for fibre diffraction, humidity; elsewhere temperature, pH, concentration — the first move is asking which conditions change the pattern
Turn the variable into an instrument: the fine-focus tube she adjusted herself, the humidity chamber she built — conditions are not 'noted' but 'controlled'
Calibrate condition-to-pattern point by point: photograph the same fibre back and forth across humidities; the reversible A/B interconversion proves you measured a law, not a fluke
Publish conditions as method, not footnote: the 1953 Acta Cryst. paper is titled 'The Influence of Water Content' — the condition itself is the contribution
representative_cases_zh: 国王学院 DNA 衍射装置的重建：她把威尔金斯订购的微照相机重新调焦校准，加装控湿系统——此前模糊的图样在数月内变成全实验室最清晰的衍射照片（贝尔纳语：'任何物质拍过的最美丽的 X 射线照片'）
A/B 两型的湿度往返实验：同一纤维 75% 湿度下是晶态 A 型、92% 下是螺旋 B 型，可逆——'两种构象'从观察变成可操作的概念
1953《含水量之影响》：把条件-图样关系本身作为论文主成果发表，为后续所有纤维衍射研究立规
representative_cases_en: Rebuilding the King's diffraction rig: she refocused Wilkins's micro-camera and added humidity control — within months previously muddy patterns became what Bernal called 'amongst the most beautiful X-ray photographs of any substance ever taken'
The humidity round-trip on a single fibre: crystalline A at 75% RH, helical B at 92%, reversible — 'two conformations' turned from an observation into an operable concept
'The Influence of Water Content' (1953): the condition-pattern relation published as the paper's main result, setting the rule for all later fibre-diffraction work
modern_applications_zh: 机器学习实验管理：先固定随机种子、数据版本与硬件环境再谈指标——'这张图是在什么条件下跑出来的'与指标本身同权重
临床与流行病学研究：诊断标准与纳入条件先于数据采集定死（registry 思维）——条件漂移的数据不可合并
生产与工程测量：把温湿度、批次、工装状态写入检测记录，使'测量结果'成为'条件+读数'的复合对象
modern_applications_en: ML experiment governance: fix seeds, data versions and hardware before quoting metrics — 'under what conditions was this run' weighs as much as the metric
Clinical and epidemiological research: diagnostic criteria and inclusion conditions fixed before enrolment (registry thinking) — data under drifting conditions cannot be pooled
Industrial metrology: temperature, humidity, batch and fixture state written into the inspection record, making a 'measurement' the compound object conditions-plus-reading

M-RFR-002（反直觉搭模法——条件先行是对'模型先行'的直接反制）
M-CUR-001（居里·实证路径法——同以一手受控测量立身，居里以放射性计量，富兰克林以衍射强度计量）
M-TOU-003（屠呦呦·条件拆解法——同以条件拆解锁定关键变量）

modes.domain_zh: 元方法/拒绝'先搭模型再找证据'的方法论 shortcut
modes.domain_en: Meta-methodology / refusing the shortcut of building a model first and finding evidence after
modes.definition_zh: 科学方法论/对'搭一个漂亮的模型再让数据支持它'的推理次序保持结构性警惕：结构应当由衍射数据经计算直接确定，而不是由纸板与直觉搭出、再拿数据来'核对'——剑桥 1951 年的三链模型把磷酸放在内侧（因电荷斥力化学上不可能）正是模型先行的高昂学费；她并非拒绝假说，而是要求假说在搭建之前先通过数据的定量检验：两链、螺距 34 埃、每转 10 碱基、磷酸在外——这些数字都先于任何模型存在于她的计算里
modes.definition_en: Scientific methodology: keep a structural suspicion of the reasoning order 'build an elegant model, then let the data endorse it' — structure should be determined directly from diffraction data by calculation, not assembled from cardboard and intuition and then 'checked' against data; the collapse of Cambridge's 1951 triple helix, with phosphates placed inside (chemically impossible under their mutual repulsion), was the expensive tuition of model-first; she did not refuse hypotheses — she required every hypothesis to pass quantitative tests against the data before assembly: two chains, 34 Å pitch, ten bases per turn, phosphates outside — these numbers existed in her calculations before any model did
modes.source_chapter: Franklin & Gosling《脱氧核糖核酸钠的分子构型》(1953, Nature 171:740)；Klug 2004 对她方法论立场的考证
modes.key_quote_zh: 结构应当从数据里算出来，而不是从纸板上猜出来再请数据点头——模型可以搭，但每个参数必须先在衍射图里有过实证。
modes.key_quote_en: Structure should be calculated out of the data, not guessed out of cardboard and then asked for the data's nod — models may be built, but every parameter must first have shown its evidence in the diffraction pattern.
key_concepts: 模型先行的学费 the tuition of model-first（1951 三链模型：磷酸在内、化学不可能）
参数先于装配 parameters before assembly（每个模型参数须先有衍射实证）
反对美学直觉的美学 the aesthetics against aesthetic intuition（'漂亮'不是结构的证据）
process_zh: 识别推理次序：当一项结论的来源是'搭出来'而非'算出来'时，把它标记为待检验假说而非结果
为模型的每个参数找数据支点：螺距对层线间距、直径对图案宽度、链数对缺层线——无支点的参数不准上桌
用最硬的物理约束先杀掉不可能项：电荷斥力判死磷酸在内的任何构型——纸板模型过不了这一关
允许别人搭模，但保留数据否决权：她检查剑桥模型'against her own X-rays, not always confirming'——实验者对模型的否决权不因模型漂亮而让渡
process_en: Identify the reasoning order: any conclusion that comes from 'building' rather than 'calculating' is flagged as a hypothesis to test, not a result
Find a data anchor for every model parameter: pitch against layer-line spacing, diameter against pattern width, chain number against the missing line — no anchor, no seat at the table
Kill the impossible first with the hardest physical constraints: electrostatic repulsion rules out any phosphate-inside configuration — cardboard cannot survive this gate
Let others build models but keep the data's veto: she checked the Cambridge model 'against her own X-rays, not always confirming' — the experimentalist's veto is not forfeited to elegance
representative_cases_zh: 对剑桥 1951 年三链模型的否证：沃森-克里克首次模型因磷酸位置被她的密度与电离数据判死——该模型当众撤回
1953 年 3 月独立手稿：在不知道剑桥进展的情况下，她由帕特森函数与缺层线写出'双链高度可能、磷酸在外'——同一结论由纯计算路径抵达
对 A 型优先的坚持：她认为更富信息的 A 型终将'由计算给出完整结构'——虽然 B 型先胜，她的次序观在后来的结构生物学里成为主流
representative_cases_en: The veto of the 1951 Cambridge triple helix: Watson and Crick's first model was killed by her density and titration evidence on phosphate position — and publicly withdrawn

The independent March 1953 manuscripts: unaware of Cambridge's progress, she wrote from the Patterson function and the missing line that a two-chain, phosphates-outside helix was 'highly probable' — the same conclusion by a pure calculation route
Her insistence on the A form: the information-richer form would in time 'yield the full structure by calculation' — B won the race, but her ordering became mainstream structural biology
modern_applications_zh: 数据科学中反对'先有结论再做显著性检验'：预注册（preregistration）与假设先于查看数据——她的'参数先于装配'的统计学后代
工程评审中把'直觉方案'降格为待验证假说：要求每个设计参数给出测量或计算依据再进入评审
AI 模型评估：禁止在测试集上'调到漂亮'——模型必须先由训练数据外推，再接受held-out数据的检验
modern_applications_en: Against 'conclusion first, significance test after' in data science: preregistration and hypotheses fixed before seeing data — the statistical descendants of parameters-before-assembly
Engineering review demoting 'intuitive designs' to hypotheses: every design parameter must show a measurement or computation before review
AI evaluation: no tuning until it looks good on the test set — models must extrapolate from training data and face held-out tests

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/以'应出现而未出现'的证据读出结构
modes.domain_en: Methodology / reading structure from evidence that should be there but is not
modes.definition_zh: 证据方法论/'没有出现'本身是一种数据：B 型衍射图的螺旋十字中，从中心向外数的第四层线缺失——层线是螺旋结构周期性的指纹，第四层线的缺席是'两链沿轴向错开 3/8 螺距'的指纹：如果两条链同相，四层线应齐备；缺一条，即是错位的签名。她由这一'不存在的证据'读出两链相对位移，并写进 1953 年 3 月的手稿——缺层线读时法的要点在于：证据的空白不是证据的缺席，把'应当出现什么'先算清楚，空白才开始说话
modes.definition_en: Evidence methodology: 'absence' is itself data — in the helical cross of the B-form pattern the fourth layer line counting outward is missing; layer lines are the fingerprint of a helix's periodicity, and the absence of the fourth is the fingerprint of two chains offset by 3/8 of a turn along the axis: had the chains been in phase the line would be there; missing, it signs the offset. From this non-existent evidence she read the relative displacement of the two chains into her March 1953 manuscript; the point of the method: an evidentiary blank is not an absence of evidence — compute first what should be present, and only then does the blank begin to speak
modes.source_chapter: Photo 51 (1952.5)；KCL 对 Photograph 51 的解读；Franklin & Gosling 1953
modes.key_quote_zh: 图上少了一层线——少得恰到好处：若两链同相它必然在场，它缺席，就是说两链错开了一段螺距；空白处写的字，要用计算去读。
modes.key_quote_en: A layer line is missing from the photograph — missing just so: had the two chains been in phase it must be there; its absence says they are offset by a fraction of a turn. The writing in the blank must be read by calculation.
key_concepts: 缺失指纹 the missing fingerprint（'应出现而未出现'作为结构签名）
先算'应有什么' compute what should be there（空白的可读性来自预期模型的完备）
空白作为证据空白 as evidence（负结果进入论证而非被忽略）
process_zh: 把'应当出现什么'先算出来：给定结构假说，列出全部预期信号（此处为螺旋各阶层线）——没有预期清单，缺失无从辨认
把'缺席'定位到具体机制：第四层线的消失不说明'测量失败'而说明'两链错相'——缺席必须能被一个更优假说解释而非被忽略
以重现性排除平凡解释：确认缺线不是曝光或样品问题（其他图样中层线齐备），使空白成为可重复的观察
把空白写进结论：'两链错开 3/8 螺距'作为由缺层线直接读出的结论进入手稿——负证据获得与正证据同格的地位
process_en: Compute what should be there first: given the structural hypothesis, list every expected signal (here, the helix's layer lines) — without the expectation list, absence is unidentifiable
Pin the absence to a mechanism: the vanished fourth line is not 'measurement failure' but 'chains out of phase' — an absence must be explained by a better hypothesis, not ignored
Exclude trivial explanations by reproducibility: confirm the gap is not exposure or specimen (other patterns show all lines), making the blank a repeatable observation
Write the absence into the conclusion: 'the chains are offset by 3/8 of a pitch' enters the manuscript as read directly from the missing line — negative evidence elevated to the rank of positive
representative_cases_zh: Photo 51 的第四层线缺失→两链错开 3/8 螺距：DNA 双螺旋'两链反向平行且错位'的关键一环由不存在的证据读出
A/B 判据的建立：B 型图中'缺线'与 A 型晶态图中层线齐备形成对照，使'构象差异'成为可观察事实
对'三链'的排除：三链的预期层线关系与实测不符——另一种'应出现而未出现'的空白，杀死了第三条链
representative_cases_en: The missing fourth line of Photo 51 → chains offset by 3/8 of a pitch: the double helix's offset two-chain character read from non-existent evidence
The A/B criterion: the B form's missing line against the A form's complete layer lines made 'conformational difference' an observable fact
Excluding a third chain: the layer-line relations a three-strand helix predicts do not match the pattern — another telling blank killed the third chain
modern_applications_zh: 安全与审计中的'应记录而未记录'：日志缺口的模式本身就是入侵或舞弊的指纹（缺失的审计记录即证据）
实验科学的预注册空缺分析：注册了却未报告的结果（reporting bias）成为系统性证据
故障诊断的负信号：本应出现的监控指标缺失/停滞，作为比异常值更强的系统异常指纹
modern_applications_en: 'Should be recorded but is not' in security and audit: the pattern of log gaps is itself the fingerprint of intrusion or fraud
Preregistration gap analysis in science: registered-but-unreported results become systemic evidence (reporting bias)
Negative signals in diagnostics: monitoring metrics that should tick but go silent — a stronger anomaly fingerprint than any outlier

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/把同一对象的两种状态做成可往返实验
modes.domain_en: Methodology / making two states of one object a reversible round-trip experiment
modes.definition_zh: 实验设计方法论/当对象呈现两种形态时，不急于宣布'有两个东西'，而是寻找让它在两种形态间往返的操作旋钮：DNA 纤维随湿度在晶态 A 型与螺旋 B 型间可逆转变——可逆性证明这是同一分子的两种构象而非两种物质，也把'构象'从描述词升格为可操作的实验概念；互变本身携带信息：转变点给出结合水的作用方式，两型图样的差给出各自的结构参数；把状态做成可往返的，分歧就从'争论'变成'实验'
modes.definition_en: Experimental-design methodology: when an object shows two forms, do not rush to declare 'two things' — look for the knob that drives it back and forth between them: a DNA fibre interconverts reversibly between crystalline A and helical B with humidity; the reversibility proves one molecule in two conformations rather than two substances, and upgrades 'conformation' from a descriptor to an operable experimental concept; the interconversion itself carries information — the transition points reveal how bound water acts, and the differences between the two patterns yield each form's structural parameters; make the states round-trippable and the dispute turns from argument into experiment
modes.source_chapter: Franklin & Gosling《脱氧核糖核酸钠纤维的结构 I》(1953)：A/B 可逆转换的系统测量
modes.key_quote_zh: 同一根纤维，降湿度回到 A，升湿度回到 B——往返自如，说明那是同一生命的两种姿势；能把分歧变成旋钮的，分歧就不再是争吵。
modes.key_quote_en: The same fibre returns to A when dried and to B when wetted — travelling freely both ways, it is one life in two postures; whoever can turn a dispute into a knob no longer argues.
key_concepts: 可逆性判据 the reversibility criterion（往返成功证明同一对象两状态）
转变点即信息 transition points as information（转变湿度给出水合机制）
旋钮化 operationalisation（把'分歧'改造成一个可操作变量）
process_zh: 怀疑'两种东西'的默认解释：当数据呈两态，先问'是否同一对象的两个状态'——A/B 之争若按两物质处理将永无结论
寻找往返旋钮：湿度、温度、pH——找一个能双向驱动转变的操作量
验证可逆性与迟滞：往返过程中记录转变点是否重合——迟滞本身也是结构信息（结合水的松弛）
以互变差分提取参数：两型图样的系统性差异（层线、子午反射）分别给出各自结构参数——一物两态成为两份数据
process_en: Doubt the default 'two substances' reading: when data show two states, first ask whether they are two states of one object — the A/B dispute is endless if treated as two materials
Find the round-trip knob: humidity, temperature, pH — an operating quantity that drives the transition both ways
Verify reversibility and hysteresis: record whether transition points coincide on the way back — hysteresis is itself structural information (bound-water relaxation)
Extract parameters from the interconversion difference: the systematic differences between the two patterns give each form's parameters — one object, two states, two datasets
representative_cases_zh: A/B 可逆转换的系统测量：同一纤维在 75%-92% 相对湿度间往返，两型重复出现——'构象'成为可操作概念
由转变行为推断水合机制：转变湿度与迟滞给出水分子结合与释放的方式——状态互变反哺了机制理解
A 型与 B 型图样的差分解读：她坚持 A 型信息更丰富，B 型给出螺旋骨架——两型互补而非对立
representative_cases_en: The systematic A/B round trip on a single fibre between 75% and 92% RH, both forms recurring — 'conformation' becomes operable
Hydration mechanism inferred from transition behaviour: the transition humidity and hysteresis reveal how water binds and releases — interconversion feeding back into mechanism
Differential reading of A and B patterns: she held the A form the richer; the B form gave the helical backbone — the two forms complementary, not opposed
modern_applications_zh: 软件性能的'两态'诊断：系统能否在降级/恢复间往返，是判断'同一服务两种状态'还是'两种故障'的判据
材料与生物体系的相变研究：以可逆性区分构象变化与降解（蛋白质折叠/变性之辨的实验判据）
A/B 测试之外的状态回滚测试：特性开关（feature flag）的双向切换验证——不可逆的'切换'暴露隐藏耦合
modern_applications_en: Two-state diagnosis in software performance: whether a system round-trips between degradation and recovery distinguishes 'one service, two states' from 'two failures'
Phase studies in materials and biology: reversibility distinguishes conformational change from degradation (the folding/denaturation criterion)
Beyond A/B tests: bidirectional feature-flag toggling — an irreversible 'toggle' exposes hidden coupling

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/由衍射数据经计算直接读出结构参数
modes.domain_en: Methodology / reading structural parameters directly from diffraction data by calculation
modes.definition_zh: 结构测定方法论/不经过'搭模型再验证'的中间环节，把衍射图样的几何与强度直接换算为结构参数：螺旋十字的张角给出螺距，子午反射的 3.4 埃给出碱基堆叠间距，十字臂上斑点间距与中心距离之比给出每转 10 碱基，图案宽度给出 20 埃直径，径向密度分布给出磷酸在外——每个参数是一条计算通道而非一次猜测；她为纤维衍射建立的这套'读图算法'（圆柱对称帕特森函数、径向密度分布）使纤维样品第一次获得与晶体同等的定量地位
modes.definition_en: Structure-determination methodology: without the intermediate step of 'build a model, then verify', convert the geometry and intensities of a diffraction pattern directly into structural parameters — the cross's arm angle gives the pitch, the 3.4 Å meridional reflection the base-stacking interval, the ratio of spot spacing to centre distance ten bases per turn, the pattern width a 20 Å diameter, the radial density distribution phosphates outside — every parameter is a calculation channel, not a guess; the 'reading algorithms' she built for fibre diffraction (cylindrically symmetrical Patterson function, radial density distribution) gave fibre specimens for the first time the same quantitative standing as crystals
modes.source_chapter: Franklin & Gosling《圆柱对称帕特森函数》(1953, Acta Cryst. 6:678)；《分子构型》(Nature 171:740)
modes.key_quote_zh: 每一层线、每一个斑点都对应一个可以直接计算的量——螺距、直径、每转残基数；读图不是欣赏图，是把图换成数。
modes.key_quote_en: Every layer line, every spot corresponds to a quantity that can be directly computed — pitch, diameter, residues per turn; reading a pattern is not admiring it, it is converting it into numbers.
key_concepts: 参数-信号映射 the parameter-signal map（每个结构量对应一条计算通道）
帕特森函数 the Patterson function（由强度直接计算原子间向量分布）
径向密度分布 radial density distribution（由衍射强度重建沿半径的质量分布）
process_zh: 为每个候选参数确定计算通道：'若要知螺距，看层线间距；若要知链数，看缺层线；若要知磷酸位置，算径向密度'——先立映射再读图
做数学准备：圆柱对称帕特森函数把纤维衍射的强度直接换算为原子间向量——为非晶纤维争取到晶体的数学待遇
交叉验证同一参数的多条通道：螺距既可由层线算、也可由十字张角算——两条通道一致才报数
把计算结果写成结构陈述而非模型图：'磷酸在外、碱基在内、每转 10 碱基'是可直接复算的陈述，不接受'请看我的纸板'式的论证
process_en: Fix the calculation channel for each candidate parameter: 'for pitch, read layer-line spacing; for chain number, the missing line; for phosphate position, compute the radial density' — mapping before reading

Do the mathematical groundwork: the cylindrically symmetrical Patterson function converts fibre intensities directly into interatomic vectors — winning crystal-grade mathematics for non-crystalline fibres
Cross-validate each parameter through multiple channels: pitch computed from layer lines and from cross-arm angle must agree before it is reported
State results as recomputable structural statements, not model pictures: 'phosphates outside, bases inside, ten bases per turn' — no 'look at my cardboard' arguments admitted
representative_cases_zh: 由 Photo 51 直接算出的参数组：34 埃螺距、20 埃直径、每转 10 碱基、3.4 埃堆叠间距——双螺旋的定量骨架先于模型存在
帕特森函数的应用：1953 年 Acta Cryst. 论文以圆柱对称帕特森函数处理 A 型数据，给出两链的向量证据
TMV 的径向密度分布（与霍姆斯合作）：以同位素置换法确定螺旋参数与 RNA 位置——同一方法学移植到病毒体系
representative_cases_en: The parameter set read straight from Photo 51: 34 Å pitch, 20 Å diameter, ten bases per turn, 3.4 Å stacking — the double helix's quantitative skeleton existing before any model
The Patterson function applied: the 1953 Acta Cryst. paper processes the A-form data with the cylindrically symmetrical Patterson, yielding vector evidence for two chains
TMV's radial density (with Holmes): isomorphous replacement fixing helical parameters and the RNA's position — the same methodology transplanted to viruses
modern_applications_zh: 测量型数据科学：把'指标'定义为一条从原始数据到结论的可复算通道（每步可审计），反对只给 dashboard 截图
反演问题工程（遥感、医学成像）：由观测直接重建参数——她的'读图算法'与今天的逆问题方法同构
审计与合规：结论必须携带可复算的计算路径（参数-信号映射），'相信我的判断'不是论证
modern_applications_en: Measurement-grade data science: define each 'metric' as a recomputable channel from raw data to conclusion, auditable step by step — against dashboard screenshots alone
Inverse-problem engineering (remote sensing, medical imaging): parameters reconstructed directly from observations — her reading algorithms as the same structure as today's inverse methods
Audit and compliance: conclusions must carry a recomputable path (parameter-signal map); 'trust my judgement' is not an argument

modes.domain_zh: 元方法/对不利于自己先前判断的证据快速采信
modes.domain_en: Meta-methodology / rapid acceptance of evidence unfavourable to one's own earlier judgement
modes.definition_zh: 认知品质方法论/判断的修订速度与证据的反对强度成正比，而不是与沉没成本成反比：她在 1951-52 年间曾怀疑 B 型是螺旋、坚持 A 型才有完整结构，甚至与戈斯林写下'螺旋 A 型之死'的讣告式玩笑——但 1953 年初，当 A 型帕特森函数的计算与 B 型缺层线共同指向'两链、螺旋、磷酸在外'时，她在数周内完成修订，1953 年 3 月的手稿写下'螺旋结构高度可能'，4 月的论文系统陈述两链证据——对自己先前判断的放弃不是失败而是方法生效的标志；修订得快，是因为判断从未被身份化
modes.definition_en: Cognitive-quality methodology: the speed of revising a judgement should be proportional to the strength of the evidence against it, not inversely proportional to sunk cost — through 1951-52 she doubted the B form was helical, held that only the A form would yield full structure, and even wrote with Gosling the joke obituary for 'crystalline helical A-DNA'; yet in early 1953, when the A-form Patterson calculations and the B form's missing line jointly pointed to 'two chains, helical, phosphates outside', she completed the revision within weeks — the March 1953 draft states the helix 'highly probable', the April paper sets out the two-chain evidence systematically; abandoning one's earlier judgement is not failure but the method working — revision is fast because the judgement was never made an identity
modes.source_chapter: 1952.7 '讣告'玩笑手迹；1953.3 手稿与 1953.4 Nature 论文的修订链
modes.key_quote_zh: 我写过螺旋 A 型的讣告——后来数据告诉我是我把讣告发错了对象；收回它，用了一周；这件事我引以为傲，不以为耻。
modes.key_quote_en: I wrote an obituary for helical A-DNA — then the data told me I had sent the obituary to the wrong address; I withdrew it in a week; I am proud of that, not ashamed.
key_concepts: 修订速度与证据强度成正比 revision speed tracks evidence strength
判断去身份化 de-identifying judgements（'我的观点'不等于'我'）
讣告的幽默 the obituary's humour（对自身判断的最终裁决权交给数据，而非情绪）
process_zh: 把每个判断标注为'当前版本'：写作与口头陈述中使用'目前证据支持'的措辞，为修订保留语义通道
设定修订触发器：什么样的新证据出现时必须重开结论（此处：帕特森函数向量证据+缺层线）——触发器先于情绪定好
快速执行修订并留下痕迹：修订过程本身可追溯（手稿、信件、讣告）——自我修正不是沉默的替换而是公开的链条
把修订结论与原判断同时发表：她同时呈现 A 型与 B 型证据，让读者看到判断移动的路径——修订成为方法论演示
process_en: Label every judgement 'current version': in writing and speech use 'the present evidence supports', keeping a semantic channel open for revision
Set revision triggers in advance: which new evidence reopens the conclusion (here: Patterson vector evidence plus the missing line) — triggers fixed before emotions arrive
Execute revision fast and leave traces: the revision chain is traceable (drafts, letters, the obituary) — self-correction is a public chain, not a silent replacement
Publish the revised conclusion alongside the original: she presents A- and B-form evidence together, letting readers see the path the judgement travelled — revision as methodological demonstration
representative_cases_zh: 从'怀疑 B 型是螺旋'到'3 月手稿写双链螺旋高度可能'：三个月内由计算证据完成 180 度修订
'螺旋 A 型讣告'事件：1952 年 7 月与戈斯林的玩笑，成为她'判断可被数据处决'的公开证物
接受剑桥模型的正确性：4 月论文肯定沃森-克里克模型与她的数据一致——'模型对了'不因'不是我想的'而被否
representative_cases_en: From doubting the B form's helicity to the March draft's 'two-chain helix highly probable': a 180-degree revision in three months, driven by calculation
The 'death of helical A-DNA' obituary: the July 1952 joke with Gosling stands as public evidence that her judgements could be executed by data
Acknowledging the correctness of the Cambridge model: the April paper affirms the Watson-Crick model as consistent with her data — 'the model is right' was not vetoed by 'it is not mine'
modern_applications_zh: 团队的判断修订制度：决策记录（ADR）标注'当前版本'与'修订触发器'，新证据到达时按预设流程重开而非靠权威改口
科学论文的注册报告（registered reports）：审稿在数据之前锁定标准，结果不利也必须发表——制度化地保护'自弃'
个人认知训练：定期写下'我上季度错在哪'并留档——把自我修正做成可追溯的公开链条
modern_applications_en: Institutionalised judgement revision: ADRs labelled 'current version' with 'revision triggers' — new evidence reopens by preset process, not by authority's change of mind
Registered reports in science: criteria locked before data, unfavourable results published anyway — institutionalising self-revision
Personal cognitive practice: periodically writing down 'where was I wrong last quarter', archived — self-correction as a traceable public chain

modes.domain_zh: 元方法/以原创续作而非诉讼回应荣誉不公
modes.domain_en: Meta-methodology / answering credit injustice with the next original work, not with litigation
modes.definition_zh: 职业伦理方法论/当数据被他人使用而荣誉旁落时，把精力从'争夺既成事实'转向'产出下一个不可替代的事实'：Photo 51 在她不知情下被出示给沃森，MRC 报告经佩鲁茨之手到达剑桥——她愤怒，但选择在 1953 年离开 King's 时把 DNA 工作完整交接（论文照发、戈斯林按程序处理学位），随即转向全新的 TMV 领域，在五年内开辟病毒结构学派；她不写回忆录控诉，不做公开对峙，而是以 Nature 1955/1956/1957 的连续原创成果让'富兰克林是谁'由后一领域回答；愤怒被转化为加速器
modes.definition_en: Professional-ethics methodology: when your data are used and the credit lands elsewhere, shift energy from contesting the fait accompli to producing the next irreplaceable fact — Photo 51 was shown to Watson without her knowledge, the MRC report reached Cambridge through Perutz; she was angry, but chose to hand over the DNA work completely upon leaving King's in 1953 (papers published as planned, Gosling's thesis processed by procedure) and turn at once to the entirely new field of TMV, founding a school of virus structure within five years; she wrote no memoir of grievance, staged no public confrontation, and let 'who is Franklin' be answered by the next field through the consecutive original results of Nature 1955/1956/1957 — anger converted into an accelerator
modes.source_chapter: 1953 年离开 King's 的交接记录；Nature 175/177/179 系列论文；Creager & Morgan 2008 的史学评估
modes.key_quote_zh: 他们拿走了一张照片——很好；那我就在另一个领域再拿出一打他们拿不走的成果；荣誉若要迟到，就让它去追一个不断前移的人。
modes.key_quote_en: They took a photograph — very well; then I shall produce in another field a dozen results they cannot take; if credit insists on arriving late, let it chase someone who keeps moving.
key_concepts: 既成事实不追认 no ratification of fait accompli（不把精力花在改写已发生的事）
下一个原创成果 the next original result（身份由最新工作定义）
程序化交接 procedural handover（离开时按学术程序交接，包括'对手'）
process_zh: 区分'可改变'与'不可改变'：数据已被出示、论文已同期发表——不可改变；下一个成果、下一批学生——可改变
按程序完成交接：把 Photo 51 与数据以规范方式留给接手者，论文以事实陈述而非控诉的口吻写就
把愤怒定向为新领域的启动资金：转战 TMV——选择一个能以既有方法论快速建立优势的战场
以连续原创定义身份：五年内 Nature 三连发，让评价体系自然更正——不亲自出席对自己的平反
process_en: Separate the changeable from the unchangeable: the photo shown, the papers published together — unchangeable; the next result, the next students — changeable
Hand over by procedure: leave Photo 51 and the data with her successors in proper form; write the papers as statements of fact, not grievance
Direct the anger as startup capital for a new field: move to TMV — a battlefield where her existing methodology could build advantage fast
Define identity by consecutive originality: three Nature papers in five years, letting the evaluation system correct itself — she never attended her own rehabilitation
representative_cases_zh: 1953 年离开国王学院的完整交接：数据、论文与戈斯林的学位安排按程序处理——对不公的处理不折损学术操守
转向 TMV 并在五年内建立病毒结构学派：1955 等长颗粒、1956 RNA 定位、1957 TYMV——'富兰克林是谁'由病毒学回答
Nature 1953.4 的平实文风：她的同期论文只陈述数据与结论，未用一行攻击性文字——回应被压缩进事实本身
representative_cases_en: The complete 1953 handover on leaving King's: data, papers and Gosling's thesis arranged by procedure — injustice handled without a hair of academic integrity lost
Turning to TMV and founding a school of virus structure in five years: 1955 equal-length particles, 1956 RNA located, 1957 TYMV — 'who is Franklin' answered by virology
The plain style of the April 1953 Nature paper: data and conclusions only, not one line of attack — the reply compressed into the facts themselves
modern_applications_zh: 知识产权与署名争议的职业处理：优先保障'下一个成果'的产出与署名链，把争议交给程序与时间
开源社区的分叉决策：社区被夺权时以 fork 出更好的版本回应，而非在旧仓库里缠斗
职场不公的个人策略：把申诉做一次、把剩余能量全部投入作品集——以作品的不可替代性重定价自己
modern_applications_en: Professional handling of IP and attribution disputes: secure the output and attribution chain of 'the next result' first; leave the dispute to procedure and time
Forking as a response in open source: when a community is captured, answer with a better fork rather than brawling in the old repo
A personal strategy for workplace injustice: appeal once, then pour every remaining ounce into the portfolio — repricing yourself through irreplaceable work

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype — answered the DNA credit dispute with five years and three Nature papers in virology

representative_figures.relation_en: the ultimate beneficiary and continuation — inheriting her methods, Nobel Chemistry 1982

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/把已打磨的方法论整体移植到新领域建立降维优势
modes.domain_en: Methodology / transplanting a polished methodology wholesale into a new field for a dimensional advantage
modes.definition_zh: 职业战略方法论/当原领域遭遇政治与人事天花板时，识别自己最可迁移的资产（不是数据而是方法），选择一个方法稀缺而问题丰富的相邻领域整体迁入：她在煤与碳（BCURA/巴黎）打磨出'由衍射读出结构'的完整方法论，在 DNA 处被体制摩擦消耗后，把它整体移植到病毒结构学——彼时 TMV 结构无人能解而材料与问题俱在，她带着帕特森函数、控湿样品与读图算法进入，两年内把一个杂学领域变成定量学科；迁移的单位是方法而非课题
modes.definition_en: Career-strategy methodology: when the home field hits political and personal ceilings, identify your most transferable asset (not data but method) and migrate wholesale into an adjacent field where that method is scarce and problems abundant — she polished the complete methodology of 'reading structure out of diffraction' on coal and carbon (BCURA/Paris), and after institutional friction drained it at DNA, transplanted it wholesale to virus structure: TMV then unsolved yet full of material and questions; she entered with her Patterson functions, humidity control and reading algorithms, and within two years turned a dilettante field into a quantitative discipline; the unit of migration is the method, not the topic
modes.key_quote_zh: 我一生只做过一件事——由衍射读结构；换的只是对象：先是煤，再是 DNA，最后是病毒——方法是我的行李，走到哪里都随身携带。
modes.key_quote_en: All my life I have done one thing — read structure out of diffraction; only the object changed: first coal, then DNA, finally viruses — the method is my luggage, carried everywhere.
key_concepts: 方法作为可迁移资产 method as the transferable asset（数据留下，算法随身）
方法稀缺域 the method-scarce field（选问题丰富而方法空白的战场）
降维优势 the dimensional advantage（老手法的成熟度对新领域构成代差）
process_zh: 盘点资产时区分'数据'与'方法'：碳研究的孔结构数据留在煤领域，但密度测量法与衍射读图法是行李
扫描相邻领域的方法缺口：病毒结构在 1953 年'问题成熟而方法缺位'——恰是纤维/粉末衍射的用武之地
整体移植并就地改造：把控湿、帕特森、径向密度方法用于 TMV，同时为病毒的螺旋对称性发展新的计算框架（与克鲁格合作）
在新领域重建学派而非单点突破：招募克鲁格、芬奇、霍姆斯，使方法在新土壤里自我繁殖
process_en: In the asset inventory, separate data from method: the carbon pore data stayed with coal, but the density-measurement and diffraction-reading methods went into the luggage
Scan adjacent fields for method gaps: virus structure in 1953 was 'mature problems, absent methods' — exactly where fibre/powder diffraction applies

Transplant wholesale and adapt in place: humidity control, Patterson functions and radial density applied to TMV, while new computational frameworks for viral helical symmetry were developed with Klug
Rebuild a school, not a single result: recruiting Klug, Finch and Holmes so the method reproduces itself in the new soil
representative_cases_zh: 煤→DNA 的迁移：BCURA 的密度测量法在 DNA 上变成'磷酸在外'的密度论证——旧方法的第一次异地增值
DNA→TMV 的迁移：控湿样品技术与读图算法整体移植，TMV 结构测定在两年内启动
病毒学派的建立：克鲁格继承并发展其方法，1982 年诺奖工作（核酸-蛋白复合物结构）的方法论源头在伯克贝克她的小组
representative_cases_en: Coal → DNA: the density-measurement method became the phosphates-outside density argument in DNA — the first appreciation of an old method on new ground
DNA → TMV: humidity-control technique and reading algorithms transplanted wholesale; TMV structure determination under way within two years
Building the virus school: Klug inherited and extended the methods — the methodological source of his 1982 Nobel work traces to her Birkbeck group
modern_applications_zh: 工程师的职业转型：把'已打磨的方法论'（如性能分析、形式化验证）整体迁入方法稀缺的新行业，而非从零学新课题
学术团队的领域扩张：以既有方法论为轴选择新对象（如把因果推断方法从经济学迁入公共卫生）
企业能力迁移：把成熟的质量/安全方法论带入监管薄弱的新兴行业建立先发标准
modern_applications_en: Engineer career pivots: migrate a polished methodology (performance profiling, formal verification) wholesale into a method-scarce industry rather than learning a new topic from zero
Research-group expansion: choose new objects along the axis of an existing methodology (causal inference from economics into public health)
Corporate capability transfer: carrying mature quality/safety methodology into under-regulated emerging industries to set the first standard

representative_figures.relation_en: the forger of the luggage — the Paris years honed 'reading structure from amorphous matter' into her core method

modes.domain_zh: 实践论/把学生与合作者当同级方法传承人培养
modes.domain_en: Practice / training students and collaborators as equal successors in the method
modes.definition_zh: 学术传承方法论/师生关系的产出不是'帮手'而是'下一个持有完整方法的人'：戈斯林作为博士生共同署名 Photo 51 并在她离开后接掌 King's 衍射工作；克鲁格作为合作者在她的读图算法上发展出病毒结构的方法框架，终获诺贝尔奖；她把完整的计算工具、样品制备诀窍与判断标准整个交出——'方法是我的行李，也可以是你的'——而非保留核心步骤以维持师徒位差；传承的单位是可复算的方法链，不是服从
modes.definition_en: Academic-inheritance methodology: the output of a mentorship is not a helper but the next person holding the complete method — Gosling, her doctoral student, co-authors Photo 51 and takes over the King's diffraction work when she leaves; Klug, her collaborator, builds the framework of virus structure on her reading algorithms and wins the Nobel; she handed over the whole of her computational toolkit, specimen craft and standards of judgement — 'the method is my luggage; it can be yours' — rather than withholding the core steps to preserve a hierarchy; the unit of inheritance is a recomputable method chain, not obedience
modes.source_chapter: 与戈斯林的共同署名与交接（1953）；与克鲁格的合作（1954-58）；Gosling 与 Klug 的回忆
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不需要一个替我摇把子的助手——我需要一个终将读图读得比我准的人；所以整套算法都给你，包括我会犯错的地方。
modes.key_quote_en: I need no assistant to turn the crank for me — I need someone who will in the end read the patterns more precisely than I; so here is the whole algorithm, including the places where I go wrong.
key_concepts: 完整交接 whole handover（工具、诀窍与判断标准一并交出）
共同署名 co-authorship（贡献以署名确认而非以口头致谢打发）
可超越性 surpassability（把'学生超过老师'预设为传承成功的标准）
process_zh: 把学生纳入方法链的每一环：样品制备、参数计算、结果判读全流程共同操作——戈斯林的双手在 Photo 51 上
以署名确认贡献边界：1953 年 Nature 论文 Franklin & Gosling 共同署名——贡献用学术制度承认而非私下感谢
为接班人设计移交路径：离开 King's 前把衍射装置与数据有序移交，保证方法在原机构延续
在合作中保留对方的原创空间：允许克鲁格发展超出她框架的方法（二十面体对称的后继工作）——传承不是复制
process_en: Bring students into every link of the method chain: specimen preparation, parameter calculation, result reading practised jointly — Gosling's hands are on Photo 51
Confirm contribution boundaries by authorship: the 1953 Nature paper reads Franklin & Gosling — contribution acknowledged by academic institution, not private thanks
Design the handover path for successors: the rig and data transferred in order before she left King's, so the method continued at the original institution
Preserve the collaborator's originality: Klug was free to develop methods beyond her frame (the later icosahedral-symmetry work) — inheritance is not replication
representative_cases_zh: Photo 51 的共同署名与完整交接：戈斯林从博士生成为接掌 King's 衍射工作的人——方法在原机构存续
克鲁格的成长路径：1954 年起与她合作，从读她的算法到发展自己的结构框架，1982 年诺奖致谢中多次回到她的起点
伯克贝克小组的建制：她组建了自己的团队并亲手训练——'有自己团队'在当时对女性科学家仍是稀缺品，她把它也变成了传承的一部分
representative_cases_en: Co-authorship and full handover of Photo 51: Gosling moved from doctoral student to head of King's diffraction work — the method surviving at the original institution
Klug's growth path: collaborating from 1954, from reading her algorithms to building his own structural framework; his 1982 Nobel lectures repeatedly return to her starting point
The Birkbeck group as institution: she built and personally trained her own team — 'having one's own group' was still rare for a woman scientist, and she made it part of the inheritance
modern_applications_zh: 工程团队的导师制：把生产级工具链与判断标准完整交给新人（含'我常错在哪'清单），而非只给边角任务
开源项目的维护者培养：以共同署名（commit 权、发布权）确认贡献，设计好 maintainer 的移交路径
知识型组织的'方法手册'文化：核心能力写成可复算的操作文档，使传承不依赖任何个人的在场
modern_applications_en: Mentorship in engineering teams: hand new people the production-grade toolchain and standards of judgement complete (including a 'where I usually err' list), not just edge tasks
Cultivating maintainers in open source: contribution confirmed by shared authorship (commit and release rights) with a designed handover path
'Method-manual' culture in knowledge organisations: core competence written as recomputable operational documents, so inheritance never depends on any individual's presence

modes.domain_zh: 制度论/在生命与任期被截断时把未竟事业交接成可持续结构
modes.domain_en: Institutional design / converting unfinished work into a sustainable structure when life or tenure is cut short
modes.definition_zh: 传承收束方法论/事业的终止可能不由自己决定（疾病、死亡、组织变动）——收束的本领是在无法到场的那天之前，把'未竟'改写成'可续'：确诊癌症后她没有降低工作强度而是加速移交——布鲁塞尔世博会 TMV 模型在她去世前一天揭幕，TMV 的数据、样品与计算框架完整留给克鲁格与霍姆斯，脊髓灰质炎病毒的结构计划以她申请的经费继续——37 岁的终点线成为病毒结构学派的起跑线；未竟收束法要求把'我会不在'当作项目的常态约束而非悲剧例外，从第一天起就为缺席设计
modes.definition_en: Inheritance-closure methodology: the end of a career may not be one's own decision (illness, death, organisational change) — the skill of closure is rewriting 'unfinished' into 'continuable' before the day one cannot be present: after her cancer diagnosis she did not slow down but accelerated the handover — the Brussels World's Fair TMV model unveiled the day after her death, TMV's data, specimens and computational framework left whole to Klug and Holmes, the polio-virus structure programme continuing on the funding she had secured — the finish line at 37 became the starting line of a school of virus structure; the method demands treating 'I will be gone' as a normal project constraint, not a tragic exception, designing for absence from day one
modes.source_chapter: 1956-58 年的移交安排；Finch & Klug 1959《脊髓灰质炎病毒的结构》；1958 布鲁塞尔世博会 TMV 模型
modes.key_quote_zh: 把模型造好，让它在我到不了的那天揭幕；把数据整理好，让接手的人第一天就能开工——事业的完整不在于我走多远，而在于停下的地方刚好有人接着跑。
modes.key_quote_en: Finish the model and let it be unveiled on the day I cannot attend; tidy the data so whoever takes over can start on day one — a career's completeness lies not in how far I run but in whether someone is standing where I stop.
key_concepts: 为缺席设计 design for absence（从第一天起以'我会不在'为约束条件）
加速移交 accelerated handover（确诊后不是减速而是加速整理与交接）
以他人之手续写 continuation by others' hands（事业的续篇由继承者的成果计数）
process_zh: 把'不可控的终点'写进项目计划：任何长期事业都假设负责人可能突然缺席——文档、样品、经费三线的完整性与成果同权重
确诊/危机后启动加速移交：优先级重排为'他人接手所需的信息'——模型、数据、样品、申请中的经费逐一清点
把收束点设在'可揭幕处'：布鲁塞尔模型按期揭幕——公开成果在缺席日交付，由共同体接住
以继承者的里程碑验收收束质量：Finch & Klug 1959 年脊髓灰质炎病毒结构、Klug 1982 诺奖——未竟事业的完成度以继承成果计量
process_en: Write the uncontrollable end into the project plan: every long venture assumes its lead may vanish suddenly — completeness of documentation, specimens and funding weighs equal to results
Launch accelerated handover upon diagnosis or crisis: priorities re-ranked as 'what another needs to take over' — model, data, specimens, pending grants itemised
Set the closure point where it can be unveiled: the Brussels model on schedule — public results delivered on the day of absence, caught by the community
Accept inheritance milestones as the closure audit: Finch & Klug's 1959 polio-virus structure, Klug's 1982 Nobel — the unfinished measured by inherited results
representative_cases_zh: 布鲁塞尔世博会 TMV 模型（1958.4.17）：她去世前一天完成的模型在'她缺席日'揭幕——收束点的精确设计
TMV 数据与框架的完整移交：克鲁格与霍姆斯在其基础上推进同位素置换与二十面体结构——未竟直接长成学派
脊髓灰质炎病毒计划的延续：以她申请的经费与计划，Finch & Klug 1959 年发表病毒结构——她启动的战场被他人完成
representative_cases_en: The Brussels World's Fair TMV model (17 April 1958): finished by her, unveiled the day after her death — the closure point precisely designed
The complete handover of TMV data and framework: Klug and Holmes advanced isomorphous replacement and icosahedral structure on it — the unfinished grew directly into a school
The polio-virus programme continued: on her funding and plan, Finch & Klug published the virus structure in 1959 — the battlefield she opened completed by others
modern_applications_zh: 关键人风险工程：核心负责人必设' bus factor 清单'（文档、权限、经费、在途事项），并定期演练交接
重病/危机下的工作收束协议：确诊后优先把'他人接手所需'整理成包——个人版的未竟收束法
科研基金的可持续设计：申请时即规划'若主持人退出'的移交条款（数据管理计划、合作者接续）
modern_applications_en: Key-person risk engineering: every lead maintains a bus-factor list (docs, permissions, funding, in-flight items) with rehearsed handovers
A closure protocol under serious illness or crisis: upon diagnosis, package first 'what another needs to take over' — the personal edition of unfinished closure
Sustainable grant design: handover clauses ('if the PI exits') planned at application — data-management plans and successor collaborators
